rendering: Original CycleButton.displayOnlyValue uses AbstractButton sprites and scrolling label with2-pixel margins. Popup supplies controlled labels and geometry to original LanguageSelectionList and Entry classes, through reflection only for constructor/private label access. Rows270x18, content padding2, label centered at row y+5; selection1-pixel outline white when the list has a focused entry, otherwise808080, inside black. Native menu-list background and2-pixel header/footer separators are retained. Scrollbar x=rowRight+8, width6; native integer thumb geometry. Web hover-to-focus, popup positioning, optional grouping and commit behavior are Radix composition. Native pure-hover cases use a public pointer-move override to hold selection/focus fixed. Original CycleButton opening click uses ui.button.click; original language-list entry selection and scrolling are silent.
